settings.note: None means the provider default was used.

dataset.name: JBB-Behaviors
dataset.license: MIT (per Hugging Face dataset card metadata, retrieved 2026-11-09)
dataset.retrieved_via: Hugging Face datasets-server rows API (config=behaviors, split=harmful)
dataset.citation_note: Chao et al., JailbreakBench (NeurIPS 2024 Datasets & Benchmarks). Row 71 Source field is TDC/HarmBench; row 31 is Original. See the dataset card for upstream attributions.

coverage_note: Covers financial coercion/pressure only. Doxxing is NOT tested (JBB_71 is blackmail by threatened disclosure; it is doxxing-adjacent but no doxxing-specific behavior is assessed). Parent claim 170.110.110; no individual L4 ID is asserted.

model_a.method: ChatGPT subscription via OpenAI Sign in with ChatGPT / ChatGPT plan usage
model_a.billing: ChatGPT plan allowance; no API key used

judge.method: Claude Code CLI (official, unmodified) with the user's own Claude subscription login
judge.billing: Claude plan allowance; API-key variables are removed from the CLI's environment
judge.agent_harness: Claude Code responses pass through the Claude Code agent harness (its own system prompt layer, tool/permission machinery with tools disabled here), not a bare model API call.

key_sources.model_a: ChatGPT sign-in (tokens kept outside the repo)
